name: Matsumae (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Matsumae town emblem in white: three curved arrows chasing each other in a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Matsumae, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in July 1954.

features.role: Matsumae town emblem — three curved arrows chasing each other in a ring
